decision_conditions: The proposal has not been demonstrated to fall within class C3(b).  Crucially, insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate that the occupants would form a single household engaging in a range of communal activities; the number of occupants plus carers would likely exceed six; the exact level of needs of the occupants has not been provided and details of the exact level of care. No details have been provided of the number of carers and if they are live-in or work on a shift basis. With regards to the applicant stating that the use has been ongoing for more than 10 years, insufficient evidence has been provided.
Consequently the proposal fails to demonstrate the lawfulness of the use proposed and a Certificate cannot be issued.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for a single residential dwelling to be used as supported living for up to 6 adults receiving care under planning class use C3B
